fields.description: What the quoted price includes. The actual treatment is settled in Phase 3 against a recorded CA confirmation.

fields.label: Signature Block
fields.description: Appended to every outreach message. Plain text - WhatsApp bold markers are preserved.

fields.label: Enforce Serial Uniqueness
fields.description: The national portal rejects submissions containing a repeated module or inverter serial.

fields.label: Contractual Performance Ratio %
fields.description: The consumer-vendor agreement requires 75% at commissioning, maintained for five years.

fields.description: Costs a visit's travel. Left at zero, every site visit looks free.

fields.description: One domain per line. Signups from these addresses are refused.

Mode
fields.description: Mock runs a simulated gateway with no real money and no credentials - for trying the flow end to end. Test uses Razorpay's own test keys. Live takes real payments.

fields.label: Webhook Path Token
fields.description: A non-obvious segment in the webhook URL. Signature verification is the real control; this only keeps casual traffic away.

fields.options: The RBI Digital Payments E-mandate Framework governs recurring debits. These values reflect the framework as understood at build time and must be re-verified against current RBI guidance before go-live. See docs/COMPLIANCE_NOTES.md.

fields.label: No-AFA Debit Ceiling
fields.description: RBI e-mandate threshold on the TOTAL debit including tax. Above this every debit needs Additional Factor Authentication. The higher one-lakh ceiling covers insurance, mutual funds and card bills only - a SaaS subscription does not qualify.

fields.label: Mandate Headroom %
fields.description: Registers the mandate maximum above the current debit, so adding users or upgrading does not immediately invalidate it.

fields.label: Pre-Debit Notice (hours)
fields.description: Mandatory advance notice before any auto-debit. 24 hours is the regulatory minimum and a lower value is refused.

fields.label: Send Post-Debit Confirmation
fields.description: Required after every collection.

fields.label: GST Rate %
fields.description: On the SaaS subscription supply - unrelated to the tenant's own solar contracts. Confirm with the CA before go-live.

fields.label: Company State Code
fields.description: Two-digit GST state code of the supplier, e.g. 32 for Kerala.

fields.label: Enable e-Invoicing
fields.description: Mandatory above the prevailing turnover threshold. Check current CBIC guidance before go-live.

fields.options: The whole payment flow works in tracking mode with this off. Nothing reaches a ledger until it is on and the accounts below are mapped. Same discipline as the Projects tab.

fields.label: Refund Approval Threshold
fields.description: Above this a refund needs a billing manager's explicit approval.

fields.options: Provisioning runs privileged operations - creating companies, users and roles - triggered by an inbound webhook. Everything on this tab shapes what a stranger's payment is allowed to build.

An architectural decision, not a toggle. Multi Company is right for the first twenty to fifty tenants and lets you ship; Multi Site is right once one tenant's data loss would end the business, or one tenant's volume degrades everyone else's queries. Changing this is blocked once any Tenant exists - see docs/TENANCY_MODEL.md.

fields.label: Reserved Codes
fields.description: One per line or comma separated. A tenant code matching any of these is refused.
fields.default: admin, api, www, app, mail, support, billing, help, status, docs, blog, shop, static, assets, cdn, ftp, smtp, imap, dev, test, staging, demo, root, system, frappe, erpnext, a3sola, sola, tenant, platform, portal, login, signup, account

fields.label: Fiscal Year Start
fields.description: MM-DD. India's year starts 1 April.

fields.label: Fallback Role Profile
fields.description: Used when the plan names no role profile.

fields.label: Pending Invitation Multiplier
fields.description: Allows inviting a little beyond the seat count to cover non-responders. The quota still binds at acceptance.

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Manual Approval queues the job and waits for a human. Worth using for the first few tenants.

fields.options: The last line of defence against one tenant reading another's ledger. It is a gating step: a tenant that fails it is never handed to a customer.
Invitation sending and acceptance are both reachable by people who are not yet your customers. These are the ceilings, per hour.

name: A3 Sola Settings
description: Site-wide configuration shared by every tenant. Deliberately unreachable by any customer role: in a multi-company deployment one tenant editing this would change behaviour for all of them. The app reads it through helpers that bypass permissions, so nothing functional depends on a customer being able to open it.
